scenario: LDIA.2.10.7 — a program imports libraries only. The imported file `prog` has a `use` directive, so it is a program, and importing it is DS_VALIDATE_IMPORT_OF_PROGRAM at the `import` line. Drives import resolution after the imported file parses.
rules_ds:
use default

import prog

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

libraries.prog:
use default

schema Other scope logical:
    v: Int key
